name: Do I need to hire a general contractor for a garage-to-rental conversion?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to hire a general contractor for a garage-to-rental conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: While some homeowners consider managing parts of the project themselves, hiring a general contractor for a garage-to-rental conversion is highly recommended. A general contractor oversees the entire project, from initial design and permitting to final inspections. They coordinate trades, manage schedules, ensure adherence to building codes, and can often secure better pricing from subcontractors and suppliers. This expertise helps ensure the project is completed efficiently, safely, and to code, saving you time and potential costly mistakes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hiring a general contractor is highly recommended for garage conversions, as they manage the entire project, coordinate trades, ensure code compliance, and streamline the process.
